Discom & Zone summary

Final mapping: approved UPPCL zones and the supplied Circle master are shown. Zone Office is used when a zone is identified but no circle can be identified. Office codes are resolved through SDO/DIV/CIR/ZNE hierarchy; SD0 is treated as SDO; KV is KESCO; long numeric office codes and clear zone names are also used where safe.

Needs review

The approved zone master and supplied Circle master are used. Devices identified to a zone but not to a listed circle are counted under that zone’s Zone Office. Devices with a known DISCOM but no zone are counted under Other office. Each DISCOM also has a fixed HQ category.

Manual count corrections

Use + Add correction to select only the DISCOM, zone, HQ or Other office that needs correction. The original Prev/Curr counts are shown automatically; enter only the corrected count. Add as many corrections as required.

Offices with reduced count from previous day

Shows offices where the adjusted current count is lower than the adjusted previous count. Expand an office to see system names present yesterday but not present in that same office today.
